calculate.title: Import cost calculator
calculate.subtitle: Get an indicative import-cost estimate powered by live AMG rate cards and tariffs.
calculate.leadBody: Share your details to view the full breakdown. Our team can refine this into a formal quotation.
calculate.disclaimer: These calculations are estimates by AMG only. Actual URA values may differ based on their valuation, HS classification, exemptions, and applicable tariff schedules. Final quotation follows cargo inspection and official customs assessment.
calculate.seaCbmHint: Sea freight uses CBM from length × width × height. Shipment CBM:
calculate.seaDimsRequired: For sea cargo, enter length, width, and height (cm) for every product.
calculate.descriptionRequired: Enter a product description for product {n}.
calculate.invalidPhone: Enter a valid phone number (8–15 digits, optional +country code).
calculate.productValueTaxNote: Please fill product value to get accurate tax estimates.
calculate.uploadTitle: Upload packing list or commercial invoice
calculate.uploadNotice: If you upload a packing list or commercial invoice, include columns for HS code, description, quantity, unit or total value (USD), weight (kg), and for sea cargo length / width / height (cm) or CBM. Missing HS codes will make duty estimates incomplete.
calculate.uploadHeaders: Accepted headers include: HS Code, Description, Quantity, Unit Price / Total Value, Weight kg, Length cm, Width cm, Height cm, CBM.
calculate.uploadSuccess: Imported {count} product(s). Missing HS code on {missingHs} row(s). Review and edit before calculating.
calculate.uploadEmpty: No product rows found. Check headers match the sample.
calculate.uploadError: Could not read that file. Use CSV or Excel (.xlsx).
calculate.uploadPdfNote: PDF and photo files cannot auto-fill product rows. Please upload CSV or Excel, or enter products manually.
